node.title: Re: Are "use constant" constants really inlined?
node.author: Athanasius
node.doctext:
Hello [Darkwing],

Yes, [doc://B::Deparse] shows that they are indeed inlined:

17:21 >perl -MO=Deparse -e "use constant { C => 42, D => 0 }; print C; print 'Debug' if D;" use constant ({'C', 42, 'D', 0}); print 42; '???'; -e syntax OK 17:28 >

Hope that helps,

Athanasius <[href://http://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=John%203:16&version=NLV|°](((>< contra mundum [href://http://translate.google.com.au/#la/en/Iustus%20alius%20egestas%20vitae%2C%20eros%20Piratica%2C|Iustus alius egestas vitae, eros Piratica,]
